component.name: Lid Mode
component.summary: Keep your laptop running with the lid closed

description.p: Lid Mode turns your laptop into a small always-on machine. Switch server mode on and close the lid: the screen turns off, but the computer keeps running, so SSH sessions, downloads, builds and background servers stay alive.

It works by holding a logind inhibitor for the lid switch, idle time and suspend, so neither closing the lid nor the desktop's automatic suspend can put the machine to sleep. Nothing is installed as a boot service and nothing changes permanently: switch it off and the laptop behaves normally again.

Server mode can run until you turn it off, or for a chosen number of hours. While it is on, a warning appears if you are running on battery, since a closed lid keeps draining it. Closing the window keeps Lid Mode running in the background; quitting it turns server mode off.
